mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an easy and convenient means of reaching clients."
Virtual counselling is an easy and convenient means of reaching clients.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most important single record which provides for the recording of important data on the student."
The cumulative record folder is the most important single record which provides for the recording of important data on the student.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the relative low number of professionally trained counsellors to the entire population that needs the services."
Among these factors is the relative low number of professionally trained counsellors to the entire population that needs the services.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a body of trained guidance counselors mainly, but it encourages interested individuals in the helping professions to join it."
The Association is a body of trained guidance counselors mainly, but it encourages interested individuals in the helping professions to join it.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a continuum and any kind of division imposed on it is more or less arbitrary."
History is a continuum and any kind of division imposed on it is more or less arbitrary.

Counselling process is the procedure and ways by which clients' problems are worked through.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the chief executive within the secondary school- system."
The school-principal is the chief executive within the secondary school- system.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a process of helping individuals or group of people to gain self-understanding in order to be themselves."
Counselling is a process of helping individuals or group of people to gain self-understanding in order to be themselves.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a system of religious beliefs and rituals."
Cultism is a system of religious beliefs and rituals.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the same thing as preparatory or preparation stage."
The initial phase is the same thing as preparatory or preparation stage.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ can be defined as methods or ways of doing something or performing an act efficiently."
Technique can be defined as methods or ways of doing something or performing an act efficiently.
